name: check-hiking-gear
description: Generate and verify a hiking gear checklist optimized for season, duration, difficulty, and group size with weight management. Covers the ten essentials, layering systems, navigation tools, emergency kit, and group gear distribution. Use when preparing for a day hike or multi-day trekking tour, packing for a group and distributing shared gear, adapting a standard gear list to specific conditions, reviewing gear before departure, or managing pack weight for long or technical routes.
